Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! (stands up and starts pacing around the room) You're just trying to poison me! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, stop this. You're not thinking clearly. Just take the pills, please 🙏.

JACK:
(suddenly calm) No. I won't take them. But I'll prove they're safe. (walks over to Dr. Smith and takes his hand) Watch this. (looks up at Dr. Smith with a mischievous grin) Watch me disappear. 🔮

Dr. Smith looks at Jack in confusion, but then, to his horror, Jack's body begins to fade away, like a ghost vanishing into thin air 👻.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) What...what just happened? 🤯

As Dr. Smith looks around the room, he realizes that Jack is truly gone. But then, he looks down at his own hands and sees that they are shaking, and his eyes are wild and unfocused 🤪.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering to himself) Oh no...oh no...I'm the one who's been pretending to be sane all along 🤯.

The camera zooms out, and we see that Dr. Smith is sitting in his office, surrounded by papers and files, but his eyes are wild and his hair is disheveled. He looks up at the camera, and we see that he is staring at us with a crazed look in his eye 👻.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
